teaser.en: Green above, silver below: the Digo know this Croton by the two colours of its leaves.
teaser.sw: Kijani juu, fedha chini: Wadigo huijua Croton hii kwa rangi mbili za majani yake.
teaser.dg: Chijani dzulu, rangi ya feza photsi: Adigo anaumanya *Croton* uhu kpwa rangi mbiri za makodzage.

summary.en: Mtsunduzi is Croton megalocarpoides, a shrub or small tree of the dry coastal country. Pakia gives it as one of the few plants the Digo identify by leaf colour.
summary.sw: Mtsunduzi ni Croton megalocarpoides, kichaka au mti mdogo wa maeneo makavu ya pwani. Pakia anautoa kama mojawapo ya mimea michache ambayo Wadigo huitambua kwa rangi ya majani.
summary.dg: *Mtsunduzi* ni *Croton megalocarpoides*, chitsaka au muhi mdide wa tsi kavu ya pwani. Pakia anauandika dza mwenga wa mimea michache ambayo Adigo anaimanya kpwa rangi ya makodza.

about.en: Mtsunduzi is a shrub or small tree up to about 8 m, with grey bark that cracks into rectangular scales. Its leaves are green above and silvery beneath. Digo people describe this as 'ndani n’maru, konze n’mereru', green on the upper surface and whitish on the lower. Its fruits are three-lobed capsules, as in other crotons.
about.sw: Mtsunduzi ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye kimo cha hadi takriban mita 8, wenye gome la kijivu linalopasuka katika magamba ya mstatili. Majani yake ni ya kijani upande wa juu na ya rangi ya fedha upande wa chini. Wadigo hueleza hali hii kwa kusema 'ndani n’maru, konze n’mereru', kijani upande wa juu na weupe hafifu upande wa chini. Matunda yake ni vifuko vyenye pindo tatu, kama ilivyo kwa Croton nyingine.
about.dg: *Mtsunduzi* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaofika hadi phephi mita 8, wenye gopha ra rangi ya ivu rinaroahuka vipande-vipande vya pembe nne. Makodzage ni ga chijani dzulu na ga rangi ya feza photsi. Adigo anaeleza hivi: '*ndani n’maru, konze n’mereru*', yani chijani uphande wa dzulu na nyereru-nyereru uphande wa photsi. Matundage ni matunda makavu genye seemu tahu, dza ga *Croton* zanjina.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal bushland and forest from southern Somalia to Mozambique, in Kenya from near sea level to about 275 m.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu na misitu ya pwani kuanzia kusini mwa Somalia hadi Msumbiji; nchini Kenya kutoka karibu na usawa wa bahari hadi takriban mita 275.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na matsakani mwa tsi kavu ya pwani, kula Somalia ya kusini hadi Mozambique. Kenya unaphahikana kula phephi na bahari hadi phephi mita 275 dzulu ya bahari.

culture.en: Pakia notes that Digo plant description uses only three basic colour words, nyiru, nyereru and kundu, so colour seldom separates species. Mtsunduzi is one of the exceptions: its two-toned leaves make it identifiable on sight.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba maelezo ya mimea ya Kidigo hutumia maneno matatu tu ya msingi ya rangi, nyiru, nyereru na kundu, kwa hiyo rangi mara chache hutenganisha spishi. Mtsunduzi ni mojawapo ya mimea isiyofuata kanuni hiyo: majani yake ya rangi mbili huufanya utambulike kwa kuuona tu.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo achieleza mimea anahumira maneno mahahu tu ga rangi, *nyiru*, *nyereru* na *kundu*, kpwa hivyo mara nyinji rangi taitafwautisha aina. Ela *Mtsunduzi* ni tafwauti: makodzage ga rangi mbiri ganahenda umanyikane mara mwenga uchiuona.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsunduzi but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Croton megalocarpoides.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsunduzi lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Croton megalocarpoides.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsunduzi*, ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ganagohumirwa ni luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Croton megalocarpoides*.

reason.sw: Nao pia hutambuliwa kwa majani ya rangi mbili
reason.dg: Piya unamanyikana kpwa makodza ga rangi mbiri

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa porini unaokua haraka
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa weruni unaokula upesi

reason.en: Another member of the spurge family
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa familia ya mibono
